title: Vision SLR® Beacon
subtitle: Compact low-profile beacon, single-color or split-color LED, surface or magnetic mount.
description: The Federal Signal Vision SLR® Beacon delivers high-output LED warning performance in a compact, low-profile beacon housing. Available in single-color and split-color (Matching or Clear dome) configurations across Red, Amber, Green, and Blue, it mounts via permanent surface or magnetic base for police vehicles that need a discreet, purpose-built warning beacon.
summary_bullets: 360-degree LED beacon with Vision® SLR technology
Available in single and multi-color configurations

features: Available in Red, Amber, Green, and Blue
benefits: Purpose-built for police vehicles needing a compact, discreet beacon
Dead-end-prevention filter logic — only valid SKU combos enabled
applications: Municipal police patrol — supplemental beacon warning
Auxiliary and rear-deck warning lighting for patrol vehicles
